name: People.cn CO., LTD
summary: People.cn CO., LTD provides advertising and publicity services in China. The company offers advertising and publicity services in the form of links, pictures, and multimedia through People.cn, the "People.cn+" client, and network operation platforms, as well as activity and event service platforms, such as Huanqiu.com and Overseas.cn. It also provides professional technical services, including website construction, hosting, and network access to social users; software development services and software platform construction services; construction services; full-process public opinion management through SaaS products; news, public opinion, life, big data platform; entertainment, and other info…
